summary: Mr. Mosseri explains the minhagim regarding the seuda of Sheva Berachot following a wedding. He details the use of one or two cups of wine and provides a step-by-step guide for the zimmun and the recitation of the six berachot.
subjects: Seuda of the haatan and kala
questions: Should I use one cup or two cups for Sheva Berachot?
What extra words are added to the zimmun at a wedding meal?
